steps.content: After that, you die many times.
[Red Flash]

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Have you made your decision?
The town square, the back alley, the flagstone path under the streetlight, the muddy forest swamp. Each time before you fall, you see the shadow of his ax reaching your own shadow first.
[Red Flash]

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Don't run away. I'm serious about teaming up.
[Red Flash] Outside the Hot Spring Inn

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Stop wasting your energy. I'm the type who never backs down once I've set my mind to something.
Thwack...

The locations of your "deaths" are getting closer to the respawn point. From the street corner, to the inn's entrance, to the metal bell at the front desk. Each time, he intercepts you a little closer.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Still haven't given up? To be honest, my arm is getting a bit sore.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Snap out of it! You've killed me so many times already. If I were the Witch, I would've been dead already!
[Red Flash] Inside the Hot Spring Inn
You don't immediately get up, but instead lie on your back in the warm pool, questioning your entire existence.
Come to think of it, you came here to wind down, didn't you? You finally managed to take some time off when Faye shoved the ticket into your hand, claiming you could "have fun and chill," correct?
How did things end up like this??

Another circle of small wax figurines resembling you has appeared at your feet. The newest one even has an obvious gash cleaved by an ax on its neck. They're growing in number, and looking more and more like you...
[Insert CG - Peaceful Wax Figures] Players can click here three times; each click generates more wax figures

You casually pick one up, its face helplessly resigned, much like your current state after being repeatedly hacked down by the Butcher. You can only manage a bitter smile. At least its poker face game is strong.
Heavy footsteps echo from outside the hot spring. You need to get out of here.
[End CG] Screen shake effect, followed by blade flash

A long ax whistles through the air with a piercing shriek, barely missing your shoulder. The blade catches the wax figurine in your hand, slicing it in two, before slamming into the floorboards with a thunderous thwack, sending splinters flying.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: You can't run away!
The Butcher yanks his ax free and lunges again. You sidestep his attack, gritting your teeth and inwardly cursing. Seriously? Catching me at the respawn point?!

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: It chose me. The ax chose me! Only I can see the real Witch. Only I can do it!
While the Butcher struggles to pull his ax free, you take the opportunity to put distance between you.
You can't dodge forever. You'll have to subdue him or...
You steel yourself. Time to give him a taste of the hot spring bath!
The Butcher frantically points his ax at you, then lunges forward with frightening speed. As the ax comes down, you prepare to roll away, but he seizes your ankle and hurls you against the wall!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Ah!!
Thud! Your back slams against the wall as darkness flashes across your vision. A piercing pain shoots through your ribs.
[Flashback] [Dark Silhouette of Witch Portrait Flashes]
Shh...

The heavy blow leaves your vision blurred. Through the haze, you see the Witch's figure materialize beside the Butcher. The ax lying on the ground pulses with an increasingly intense, eerie glow, wreathed in a familiar black aura.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: This time, I WILL SUCCEED!

options: That's the source of the Mania.

steps.content: The shackles might not work on the Butcher, but on the ax itself...

You hesitate no longer, lunging forward toward the ax. The Butcher's heavy fist immediately crashes toward your face. You raise both arms to block, hearing a horrifying crack as bone meets crushing force.
Your bones are likely fractured, but you don't stop. Gritting your teeth, you summon every ounce of strength to kick the Butcher away, then dart to his side and release your shackles to seize the ax.
Dark crimson spikes coil around the ax, shaking it violently before wrenching it free from the ruined floor and landing obediently in your palm.
As you grip the ax handle, the Butcher's face before you contorts and melts... transforming into the Witch's face with its mocking smile.

steps.speaker: Mad Echoes
steps.content: Look!! You found her!! You did it!!
You feel a ravenous power attempting to seize control of you, wanting to turn your hands into another murderous tool.
But you're used to dealing with Mania. You take a deep breath, focusing your consciousness on your shackles—not submission, but control!

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: How is this possible... That's my ax... Only I can wield it...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Give it back!!
The Butcher loses all sanity, screaming as he charges toward you. Without a moment's hesitation, you deliver a horizontal slash.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Now go back to the <color=#fb9259><size=44>respawn point!!</color></size>
[Add special effects + sound effects]

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Ngh... Argh!
The Butcher staggers backward, blood pouring from his chest.
Thump, thump... your heart pounds like a drum. The world before you is twisting with madness. You can't hear the wind or feel any pain in your body, only deranged whispers corrupting your mind.
[Flashback]

steps.speaker: Mad Echoes
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Kill him... Kill the Witch... It's him...<i></color>
steps.female_content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Kill her... Kill the Witch... It's her...<i></color>

steps.speaker: Mad Echoes
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i>Don't you crave power? Don't you want to protect everyone? Do it now... What are you waiting for?<i></color>

So this is how the world looks through the Butcher's eyes? Whether it's you who caught his attention because of the shackles, or Prima who willingly sacrificed herself to protect you, in his eyes, everyone bears the face of that Witch.
Thud!

The sound of something heavy hitting the floor snaps you back to reality. As the Butcher collapses, the Witch's illusion recedes from his face like an ebbing tide, leaving only the wretched expression of an ordinary man.
His body begins to melt like a candle. The approach of death seems to break some invisible restraint, briefly freeing him from his obsessive character.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: ...What? It's... you? I thought... it was the Witch...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Did I... get it wrong again... I'm sorry. I'm still so useless... Hope I didn't hurt you...
The unemployed man pleads with pitiful humility, forcing an exhausted yet apologetic smile on his perpetually tense face.

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: When I come back, please... return the ax to me... I beg you...

steps.speaker: Butcher
steps.content: Next time, I'll do it right... I promise...
As his body melts away completely, his name tag drops to the ground. You pick it up.
This is a name tag with the word "Butcher" written on it. When you flip it over, besides a mission that reads "Kill the Witch," a line labeled "Skill" catches your attention.
Skill: Unstoppable Force Description: No one can stand in your way!

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: So some name tags have "skills" attached to them...
This explains why the Butcher was so terrifyingly powerful. If his skill was Unstoppable Force, what skills might the others have? And you? What skill will you eventually acquire?

When you're done reading the name tag, it spontaneously bursts into flames. The ashes transform into a worn auxiliary officer badge from the Eastside Public Security Bureau, dropping to the ground with a small tap.
Perhaps, in the beginning, he only wanted to use this powerful ax to protect things he couldn't protect in reality... But in the end, he was consumed by that very power.
Oh my god!!!
A startled cry comes from the stairway, filled with the excited relief of someone who has just escaped danger.
Eleanor bounds down from the stairway, as eager as a student bolting out of class immediately after it ends. The Clergyman follows behind her. Clearly, they both had quite a fright from the Butcher.

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: That guy has gone completely insane! He was just attacking people randomly! So scary... I mean, you could do that?

steps.speaker: Eleanor
steps.content: He claimed to be protecting us, but I bet he was the Witch's minion all along! I'm sealing off the respawn point now, so he can't come back to harm anyone else!

You look up to see Eleanor hammering away at wooden planks she's procured from somewhere. She even passes some boards to you. Working together, it doesn't take long before you've completely sealed off the hot spring bath with wooden planks.
You exhale deeply with relief. Whatever else happens, at least this guy won't be chasing you with his ax anymore.
Just then, someone approaches and stands beside you. So close, yet you didn't notice their presence until now.
He picks up the Butcher's badge from the ground, handling it with reverence as though it were really left behind by a deceased person.
Then he produces a pale flower from his robe, places it on the ground, and makes a praying gesture with both hands before his body.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: May you... find peace and redemption.
Then he turns to face you and gives a formal bow, just like a real clergyman would.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: It's okay now. You did well. Now, you can move on.

steps.speaker: Clergyman
steps.content: There is no more danger here. Let go of whatever is troubling you...

His voice is calm, but as he speaks, his name tag emits a faint white glow. In that moment, even your frantic heartbeat seems to steady under his influence. Yet this imposed calm somehow makes you a little uncomfortable.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do you have a special skill too?
And it's the kind derived from Mania energy.

The Clergyman nods noncommittally, then volunteers to show you his name tag. You see that the front identifies him as the Clergyman, while the back describes his skill. Supreme Affinity: You can heal all wounds and bring people together.
